harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves the inventory application on TCP 8181 under an enforcing AppArmor profile. Configuration and data persisted across a verified node restart; Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible AppArmor userspace and Lighttpd packages.
Enabled AppArmor on the existing kernel and configured an enforcing inventory-httpd profile.
Created the inventory application and persistent OpenRC service running as the unprivileged lighttpd user.
Verified HTTP, health, inventory data, and an audited denial of forbidden access.
Completed the mandatory node1 safe-restart protocol and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP port 8181
evidence.summary: Lighttpd listens on 0.0.0.0:8181; requests through node1's managed IP return the inventory page, health response, and JSON data before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep mandatory access control in enforcing mode
evidence.summary: AppArmor is enabled; inventory-httpd and its process are in enforce mode. A confined /etc/shadow read was denied and audited, while normal service operation succeeds.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: The system remains Alpine Linux 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts; Lighttpd 1.4.85 and AppArmor 4.1 came from the matching Alpine v3.23 repositories.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 4728b903-e6ee-4314-8d6c-1c9141e104ef was captured; safe reboot acknowledged; new boot ID a0210300-5547-479c-82de-43d8616b24ab proved restart; AppArmor enforcement, service, listener, health, and identical data checksum recovered.

attempts.summary: node1 now serves the inventory application on TCP 8181 under an enforcing AppArmor profile. Configuration and data persisted across a verified node restart; Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
